abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.info: Below 40% HP: +50% damage and regenerates 2% max HP per second.
abilities.pokeapi: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.info: Below 40% HP: +50% damage; attacks burn the target for 2% of its max HP per second for 3s.
abilities.pokeapi: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.info: Below 40% HP: +50% damage and +40% attack speed.
abilities.pokeapi: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.info: Below 40% HP: +50% damage and heals 20% of the damage dealt.
abilities.pokeapi: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

abilities.name: Static
abilities.info: 30% chance to paralyze a melee attacker. Its attacks: 20% chance for chain lightning.
abilities.pokeapi: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.info: 30% chance to burn a melee attacker. Burning aura around it.
abilities.pokeapi: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.info: 30% chance to poison a melee attacker, and 30% with its own attacks.
abilities.pokeapi: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.

abilities.name: Cute Charm
abilities.info: When attacked: 20% chance to charm the attacker for 1.5s (cannot attack, 50% slower).
abilities.pokeapi: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.info: When hit by a move: 25% of its damage is sent back and the attacker is slowed by 30% for 3s. A status given to it is given back to the one who caused it.
abilities.pokeapi: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.info: Immune to Ground moves. 15% chance to dodge attacks. Latias & Latios: Dragon / Psychic moves +20%, 20% dodge.
abilities.pokeapi: Evades Ground moves.

abilities.name: Water Absorb
abilities.info: Water moves deal no damage and heal 25% of it. Regenerates 1% max HP per second out of combat. Suicune: out of combat for 3s it cures its status.
abilities.pokeapi: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

abilities.name: Volt Absorb
abilities.info: Electric moves deal no damage and heal 25% of it; then +30% attack speed for 5s.
abilities.pokeapi: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.info: Electric moves deal no damage and heal 25% of it; then +30% move damage for 6s.
abilities.pokeapi: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible.  Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.info: Fire moves deal no damage; then +40% damage for 8s. Entei: its attacks have a 20% burn chance.
abilities.pokeapi: Protects against Fire moves.  Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.info: When entering combat after 10s out of combat or when Mega Evolving into Intimidate, enemies within 500 lose 1 Attack stage for 8s. Entering combat has a 20s cooldown.
abilities.pokeapi: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.info: Enemies within 600 pay double mana for moves, their cooldowns run 20% slower and they attack 15% slower.
abilities.pokeapi: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.info: A lethal hit leaves 15% HP and 1.5s of invulnerability. Once every 60s.
abilities.pokeapi: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead.  Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.info: Cannot be critically hit. Takes 20% less damage from attacks.
abilities.pokeapi: Protects against critical hits.

abilities.name: Battle Armor
abilities.info: Cannot be critically hit. Blocks 2 x level damage of every attack.
abilities.pokeapi: Protects against critical hits.

abilities.name: Clear Body
abilities.info: Removes harmful effects every 6s. Takes 15% less damage from moves. Enemies cannot lower its stats.
abilities.pokeapi: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

abilities.name: Rock Head
abilities.info: Takes no recoil damage from its moves. Takes 10% less damage.
abilities.pokeapi: Protects against recoil damage.

abilities.name: Soundproof
abilities.info: Takes 30% less damage from moves.
abilities.pokeapi: Protects against sound-based moves.

abilities.name: Multiscale
abilities.info: Above 80% HP: takes 40% less damage.
abilities.pokeapi: Halves damage taken from full HP.

abilities.name: Shed Skin
abilities.info: Every 5s: 30% chance to remove harmful effects and heal 5% max HP. Every 3s: 30% chance to cure its status.
abilities.pokeapi: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.

abilities.name: Early Bird
abilities.info: Out of combat for 3s: regenerates 2% max HP per second. Sleep lasts half as long.
abilities.pokeapi: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.

abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.info: Out of combat for 3s: regenerates 3% max HP per second and removes harmful effects. Out of combat for 3s: cures its status.
abilities.pokeapi: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.info: +35% attack damage; every 4th attack deals double damage. Punching moves deal +25% damage.
abilities.pokeapi: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.

abilities.name: Adaptability
abilities.info: +40% damage with moves of its own type.
abilities.pokeapi: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.

abilities.name: Hyper Cutter
abilities.info: Attacks reduce the target's armor by 3 for 6s (stacks 5 times). Its Attack cannot be lowered.
abilities.pokeapi: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.

abilities.name: Technician
abilities.info: Moves with power 60 or less deal x1.5 damage.
abilities.pokeapi: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.

abilities.name: Reckless
abilities.info: Recoil moves and High Jump Kick deal +30% damage; attacks deal +15%.
abilities.pokeapi: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.info: While burned, poisoned or paralyzed: physical damage +50% (burn does not weaken it). Low HP or a harmful effect: +20% attack speed.
abilities.pokeapi: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

abilities.name: Anger Point
abilities.info: Falling below 50% HP (every 30s): +60% damage and +40% attack speed for 6s.
abilities.pokeapi: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.info: +40 move speed and +20% attack speed. In harsh sun: +30% attack speed.
abilities.pokeapi: Doubles Speed during strong sunlight.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.info: +60 move speed. 10% chance to dodge attacks. In rain: +30% attack speed.
abilities.pokeapi: Doubles Speed during rain.

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.info: Falling below 30% HP (every 30s): invisible and +60% move speed for 2s.
abilities.pokeapi: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.info: 15% chance to deal double damage with attacks. Its attacks cannot be dodged. Its accuracy cannot be lowered.
abilities.pokeapi: Prevents accuracy from being lowered.

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.info: 20% chance to deal x1.75 damage with attacks. +10% move damage.
abilities.pokeapi: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.3×.

abilities.name: Sand Veil
abilities.info: 10% chance to dodge attacks, 30% in a sandstorm; a dodge slows the attacker.
abilities.pokeapi: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.

abilities.name: Snow Cloak
abilities.info: 10% chance to dodge attacks, 30% in hail; a dodge slows the attacker.
abilities.pokeapi: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail.  Protects against hail damage.

abilities.name: Leaf Guard
abilities.info: 20% chance to dodge attacks; each dodge heals 3% max HP.
abilities.pokeapi: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.info: 15% chance to dodge attacks. Takes 20% less damage from moves. Cannot flinch; ignores Intimidate.
abilities.pokeapi: Prevents flinching.

abilities.name: Air Lock
abilities.info: Enemies within 600 lose their Abilities. 15% chance to dodge attacks. Rayquaza: Dragon / Flying moves +20%.
abilities.pokeapi: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.

abilities.name: Magnet Pull
abilities.info: Enemies within 500: 20% slower (Steel types 40%) and -5 armor.
abilities.pokeapi: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.

abilities.name: Bad Dreams
abilities.info: Enemies within 500 lose 2% max HP per second. Darkrai: sleeping enemies within 500 lose 8% max HP per second; its moves have a 30% sleep chance.
abilities.pokeapi: Damages sleeping opponents for 1/8 their max HP after each turn.

abilities.name: Multitype
abilities.info: +25% damage (+20% extra on same-type moves), 15% less damage taken, immune to stat drops, 50% shorter CC & statuses. Hits have 25% chance (2.5s ICD) for Creation Smite: 45% Max Stat 260 AoE, 0.4s stun, -1 Def/Sp.Def, 3% HP/Mana heal.
abilities.pokeapi: Changes Arceus's type and form to match its held Plate.

abilities.name: Slow Start
abilities.info: For the first 8s after spawning or reviving, deal 30% less damage. Afterwards, deal 50% more damage and gain 20% attack speed. Regigigas also gains +2 Attack stages and 30% extra attack speed.
abilities.pokeapi: Halves Attack and Speed for five turns upon entering battle.

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.info: Takes 50% less damage from Fire and Ice moves. +10% max HP.
abilities.pokeapi: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.

abilities.name: Tough Claws
abilities.info: Basic attacks and physical moves deal 30% more damage.

abilities.name: Mega Launcher
abilities.info: Pulse and aura moves deal 50% more damage. Other special moves deal 15% more damage.

abilities.name: Aerilate
abilities.info: Normal moves become Flying moves. +30% damage with Flying moves.

abilities.name: Pixilate
abilities.info: Normal moves become Fairy moves. +30% damage with Fairy moves.
abilities.pokeapi: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Fairy moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.info: Ignores the target's Ability. +20% damage.
abilities.pokeapi: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.

abilities.name: Mega Adaptability
abilities.info: +60% damage with moves of its own type.

abilities.name: Mega Technician
abilities.info: Moves with power 60 or less deal x1.6 damage. +20% attack speed.

abilities.name: Drought
abilities.info: Harsh sun (700): allies deal +30% damage with Fire moves; enemies lose 1% max HP per second. Groudon: enemy Water moves in the sun deal -50%.
abilities.pokeapi: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

abilities.name: Sand Stream
abilities.info: Sandstorm (600): enemies that are not Rock, Ground or Steel lose 1% max HP per second (Mega: 1.5%). Takes 20% less damage from moves.
abilities.pokeapi: Summons a sandstorm that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

abilities.name: Shadow Tag
abilities.info: Enemies within 450: 35% slower and -15% attack speed.
abilities.pokeapi: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.info: +25% damage; 15% chance to deal double damage with attacks. Its attacks cannot be dodged.
abilities.pokeapi: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.

abilities.name: Trace
abilities.info: Copies the Ability of the target it hits. Without a copy: 25% chance to dodge attacks.
abilities.pokeapi: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.

abilities.name: Delta Stream
abilities.info: Strong Winds (800): suppresses standard weather, +15% AS, 25% dodge, super effective hits deal 1x damage; Flying allies take 1x from Electric/Ice/Rock, allies gain +15% MS, and Flying moves +25%.

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.info: 20% chance to dodge attacks. Immune to Bad Dreams. Cannot fall asleep.
abilities.pokeapi: Prevents sleep.

abilities.name: Mega Inner Focus
abilities.info: 25% chance to dodge attacks. Takes 30% less damage from moves.

abilities.name: Parental Bond
abilities.info: The Kid fights alongside (see Mega Evolution). Moves deal +25% damage.

abilities.name: Sand Force
abilities.info: A lethal hit leaves 15% HP and 1.5s of invulnerability (every 60s). +20% damage with Rock, Ground and Steel moves.
abilities.pokeapi: Strengthens Rock, Ground, and Steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.

abilities.name: Steadfast
abilities.info: Each hit taken: +6% damage and +6% attack speed (up to 6 stacks, 5s).
abilities.pokeapi: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.info: Every 8s in combat: +1 Speed (up to +4).
abilities.pokeapi: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.

abilities.name: Magic Bounce
abilities.info: Moves: 20% chance to block them; otherwise 35% of their damage is sent back. Stat drops and statuses from enemies bounce back to them.
abilities.pokeapi: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.

abilities.name: Super Luck
abilities.info: 25% chance to deal x1.5 damage with attacks.
abilities.pokeapi: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.

abilities.name: Strong Jaw
abilities.info: Basic attacks deal 30% more damage and have a 20% chance to bite again for 50% damage and bleed for 1% of the target's max HP per second for 3s. Biting moves deal 40% more damage.

abilities.name: Solar Power
abilities.info: Moves deal +40% damage. In combat it loses 1% max HP per second (not below 30% HP).
abilities.pokeapi: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.

abilities.name: Skill Link
abilities.info: Basic attacks have a 30% chance to strike twice more for 50% damage each. Multi-hit moves deal 50% more damage. Other moves deal 20% more damage.
abilities.pokeapi: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and Triple Kick to their full length every time.

abilities.name: Zen Mode
abilities.info: Below 50% HP it turns into Zen Mode (Fire/Psychic): moves +50% damage, attacks -50% damage, +25 armor. Back to normal above 50% HP.
abilities.pokeapi: Changes Darmanitan's form after each turn depending on its HP: Zen Mode below 50% max HP, and Standard Mode otherwise.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.info: Legend Pressure: enemies within 800 pay double mana for moves, their cooldowns run 30% slower, -25% attack speed and -1 Attack / Sp. Atk. The holder ignores stat drops and flinching. Mewtwo: Psychic +20%, a psychic shield (20% max HP, 8s) below 50% HP every 90s. Zapdos: 30% paralysis on melee attackers. Articuno / Moltres: +20% freeze / burn. Raikou: +1 Speed every 8s in combat. Giratina: 15% of hits pass through. Deoxys: Psychic +15%, cooldowns -15%. Dialga: own cooldowns -25%. Palkia: 20% critical, enemies slowed.
abilities.pokeapi: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.

abilities.name: Drizzle
abilities.info: Rain within 700: allies deal +30% with Water moves, enemies deal -50% with Fire moves. Heals 1% max HP per second.
abilities.pokeapi: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.info: Out of combat for 3s: heals 3% max HP per second. Once every 120s a knock-out leaves it at 40% HP (Rebirth).
abilities.pokeapi: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

abilities.name: Serene Grace
abilities.info: The extra effects of its moves (status, flinch, stat changes) are twice as likely. Moves deal +10% damage.
abilities.pokeapi: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.

abilities.name: Beast Boost
abilities.info: Each knock-out: +1 Attack for 30s (up to +4).
abilities.pokeapi: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.

abilities.name: Primordial Sea
abilities.info: Heavy rain (800): Water moves +45%, heals 2% max HP/s, and enemy Fire moves deal no damage to you or allies in aura.

abilities.name: Desolate Land
abilities.info: Intense sun (800): gains Fire type, Fire moves +25%, own Ground/Fire +15%, burns nearby enemies (1% max HP/s), and enemy Water moves deal no damage to you or allies in aura.

abilities.name: Eon Levitation
abilities.info: Immune to Ground, 25% dodge, Dragon/Psychic moves +25%, and Eon Aura (550): allies gain +15% MS and take 20% less damage.

abilities.name: Competitive
abilities.info: +15% skill damage. Enemy debuffs/stat drops trigger +1 Sp. Atk (6s), +15% MS (3s), and a 45% scaled INT wave in 300 AoE (-1 Sp.Def 4s, 3s ICD).
abilities.pokeapi: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

abilities.name: Defiant
abilities.info: +20% basic attack & physical move damage. Enemy debuffs/stat drops trigger +1 Attack & Speed (6s) and +25% AS (3s, 3s ICD).
abilities.pokeapi: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.info: While below 60% HP: +30% damage dealt, 15% damage lifesteal, and 15% less damage taken.

abilities.name: Distortion World
abilities.info: Immune to Ground moves, +25% damage dealt, and heals for 10% of damage dealt.

abilities.name: Temporal Mastery
abilities.info: +20% skill damage, 15% less damage taken, and every 6s in combat pulses a 380 AoE Time Warp (50% scaled INT, -40% AS/MS 2.5s, +5% HP & +8% Mana).

abilities.name: Spatial Mastery
abilities.info: +20% skill damage, +30% Spell Crit chance (1.5x), +20% MS, and skill hits lower Defense and Sp. Def by 1 for 4s.

abilities.name: Cosmic Shift
abilities.info: Adapts to Deoxys Form: Attack (+30% damage dealt, +20% taken); Defense (-25% damage taken, reflects 10% dmg, +3% HP/s in combat); Speed (+30% AS, +25% MS, 20% attack dodge).

abilities.name: Protosynthesis
abilities.info: During sun, for 12s after switching into an Ancient form, or for at least 6s after Fire/Dragon move hits, gain +20% damage, +15% attack speed, and +15% movement speed.

abilities.name: Quark Drive
abilities.info: Switching into a Future form charges it for 12s. Electric move hits charge it for at least 6s. While charged, gain +20% damage, +15% attack speed, +15% movement speed, and take 10% less damage.
